crop.notes: Upper headline decks ('Last of the Prize Ring / The Mace-Coburn Fight / The Mill Declared a Draw / The Men Afraid of Each Other') are cut off; only 'The Referee Much Disgusted' is in the crop. The crop also runs on into an unrelated 'Kansas Items' column (pieces 5-7).

ocr.notes: Fight report readable but many character errors; the transcript also includes the unrelated Kansas Items.

title.suggested: Allen Seconds Mace in Drawn Fight With Coburn

summary.suggested: The Daily Missouri Democrat reported that Tom Allen and Jim Cusick seconded Jem Mace against Joe Coburn at Montgomery Station, Mississippi. The referee declared the fight a draw after three hours and thirty-eight minutes.

metadata.notes: Masthead reads 'Daily Democrat', Saturday morning, Dec. 2, 1871. Before the 1875 merger, so not the Globe-Democrat.

facts.fact: Allen and Jim Cusick seconded Jem Mace against Joe Coburn at Montgomery Station, Mississippi, about forty miles from New Orleans; the referee, Col. Rufus Hunt, declared the fight a draw after 3 hours 38 minutes
Allen travelled from New Orleans on the special excursion train to the Mace-Coburn fight ground

notes: Same Associated Press report as 442 (Missouri Republican, same day).
